title: Twext
description: Manifest for a Twext extension project (twext.yml).

name.description: Project name, used as a fallback for the extension name.

license.description: SPDX license identifier. Defaults to MIT.

entryPoint.description: Path to the entryPoint module. It must export a `blocks` map and may export `setup` and `methods`.

outputPath.description: Where twext build writes the compiled extension. Defaults to dist/extension.js.

id.description: Stable ID TurboWarp uses to identify the extension. Lower-case letters and digits only.

name.description: Name shown in the block palette. Defaults to the project name.

className.description: Name of the generated extension class. Defaults to a derivation of the id.

color1.description: Primary block color as a HEX value.

color2.description: Secondary block color as a HEX value.

color3.description: Tertiary block color as a HEX value.

menus.description: Dropdowns that block arguments reference via the `menu` property.

docsURI.description: Link to documentation, shown as "Documentation" in the extension's menu.

menuIconURI.description: Icon shown next to the extension's name in the palette.

blockIconURI.description: Icon shown on the extension's button in the block palette.

blocks.description: Block definitions, "---" separators, and labels. Every executable block maps an opcode to a handler exported by the entryPoint; buttons name a method with `func` instead.

anyOf.description: A space separator in the block palette.

opcode.description: Must match the key of a handler in the entryPoint `blocks` map.

func.description: Name the generated extension method is published under. Defaults to the opcode; required for buttons, which have no opcode.

text.description: Label shown on the block. Defaults to the opcode.

hideFromPalette.description: Keeps the block out of the palette while leaving it usable in existing projects.

blockIconURI.description: Icon shown on the block itself.

isDynamic.description: Marks the block as dynamic, which lets the editor and inspector target it by name.

isTerminal.description: Stops the script after the block runs instead of continuing to the next block. Command blocks only.

disableMonitor.description: Hides the block's monitor while it is dragged out. Reporters only.

isEdgeActivated.description: Whether the hat fires for every matching target instead of only fresh ones. Hats only; event blocks require false.

shouldRestartExistingThreads.description: Restarts already-running threads for a target instead of letting them finish. Hats only.

branchCount.description: Number of branches on a C-shaped block.

blockType.description: TurboWarp block type. Defaults to reporter.

defaultValue.description: Value used when the argument is left empty.

menu.description: Name of a menu declared in extension.menus that this argument selects from.

dataURI.description: Data URI for the argument's asset. Required for image, costume, and sound arguments.

flipRTL.description: Mirrors the asset when the project is right-to-left. Image and costume arguments only.

argumentType.description: TurboWarp argument type. Defaults to string.

targetFilter.description: Restricts a block or button to specific target types. Omit to allow both.

anyOf.description: Name of a method in the entryPoint `methods` export that returns the items.

menuItems.description: Menu items. Strings are shown as-is; objects display `text` and pass `value` to the block.

acceptReporters.description: Whether the menu allows reporter blocks to be dropped in. Almost always true.

anyOf.description: Name of a method in the entryPoint `methods` export that returns the items.
